Subject. P.N. Lebedeff - Candidate to join the S.M.Police ( Specials ).

Made by. U.I. Prokofiev. Forwarded by C.D.I. Tabrum.

（批：Copies sent to D.C. (Specials) 24/5.）

Pavel Nikolaevich LEBEDEFF, Russian, was born on December 25,1913 at Harbin and is reported to be the son of General Lebedeff of the Russian army. According to his own statement, his parents died about twenty years ago in Harbin, following which he was adopted by a certain Mr. P.F. Jones, British, who resides in Tsingtao at present.

The applicant received his education at the St. Louis College,Tientsin, graduating in 1929. Upon leaving school he resided in Dairen ( 1929-1932 ),Harbin ( 1932 -1936 ) and Tsingtao ( 1936-1939 ) working as a teacher of English, business correspondence etc. in various schools ,as well as giving private lessons. In June,1939 he arrived in Shanghai from Tsingtao and has since been working in the same capacity, mostly as a private teacher. He is also connected with the "OLYMPIC", a bilingual ( Russian and English ) monthly magazine devoted to sports. In March,1941 he secured his present employment ( half day only ) with the British Press Attache's Office, H.B.M. Embassy, Shanghai, as a translator. Occasionally he also works as an advertising agent for the Shanghai Evening Post & Mercury and certain radio-broadcasting stations ( XJDN and XMHC ).

He is registered with the Russian Emigrants Committee,Moulmein Road, and at present resides at 407 Avenue du Roi Albert.

There is nothing in the Municipal Police detrimental to his character.

Pavel Nikolaevich LEBEDEFF，俄国人，1913年12月25日出生于哈尔滨，据称是俄国陆军 Lebedeff 将军之子。据其自述，其父母约二十年前在哈尔滨去世，此后他被一位名叫 P.F. Jones 的英国人收养，此人目前居住在青岛。

申请人在天津圣路易斯学院（St. Louis College, Tientsin）接受教育，1929年毕业。离校后，他先后居住于大连（1929-1932）、哈尔滨（1932-1936）和青岛（1936-1939），在各学校担任英语、商业信函等课程的教师，并从事私人授课。1939年6月，他从青岛抵达上海，此后一直从事相同职业，主要作为私人教师。他还与双语（俄文和英文）体育月刊《奥林匹克》（OLYMPIC）有关联。1941年3月，他获得了目前的职位（仅半天工作），在英国驻华大使馆上海新闻专员办公室担任翻译。偶尔，他也为《上海晚邮报与水星报》（Shanghai Evening Post & Mercury）及某些广播电台（XJDN 和 XMHC）担任广告代理。

他已在莫尔美因路（Moulmein Road）的俄国流亡者委员会登记，目前居住在阿尔伯特王路（Avenue du Roi Albert）407号。

Luis Schellas Hyndman candidate for the S.M. Police
(Specials) is a Portuguese subject born in Hongkong on
July 29, 1889. He resided in Hongkong until 1924 with
the exception of eight years, from 1897 till 1905, which
he spent in Manila. In 1924 the applicant came to
Shanghai and obtained a position as a clerk in the
Hongkong and Shanghai Bank which he held until 1931.

able to obtain pupils.

Since 1937 Hyndman has been employed by various
shipping companies in Shanghai and from November 1940
until the present time he has been serving with the
Agence Roliz, 650 Szechuen Road, as Captain of the M/V.
Maria Francisca.

The candidate is registered at the Portuguese
Consulate in Shanghai - Certificate No. 602 issued on
October 3, 1939 valid till October 3, 1941. He is
in possession of a Portuguese passport No. 9 issued at
Shanghai on February 5, 1940, which is renewable each
year.

Nothing is known in police records to the
detriment of the applicant, who is given an excellent
character by his present employers.

SUBJECT: Ernst SALOMON, German Jewish refugee -

Ernst SALOMON, German Jewish
refugee, born at Dresden on May 28, 1920, arrived
in Shanghai from Europe in December 1938. Since
his arrival here he has been working in his father's
office at 138 Hamilton House, an office that spec-
ializes in the selling and buying of second-hand
goods, particularly sewing-machines.

SALOMON has tried, without success,
to secure employment in the Shanghai Municipal
Police and Customs River Police since he arrived
in Shanghai. By no means endowed with commonsense
the applicant has, on several occasions, approached
this office with one request or another. He does
not impress police-officers who have talked to
him as being an individual likely to reach the
requisite standard of intelligence needed for
members of the Specials.

Apart from the above nothing is
known to SALOMON'S detriment from a Police angle.

Ludwig GRUENEBAUM, German Jewish

Sergey Vassilievich GREBENSTCHIKOFF, Russian, born on June 8, 1889 in the province of St. Petersburg, Russia. Grebenstchikoff, naturalized French citizen, is employed in the French Municipal Police, Shanghai.

此后，鲁拜因受雇于兰伯特·邓巴公司（Lambert Dunbar & Co.，经纪人行），但最近他加入了大卫·犹大经纪公司（David Judah）。

鲁拜因在英国驻华领事馆登记为伊拉克臣民。他已婚，居住在西摩路30/12号。他曾在上海万国商团（S.V.C.）服役5年。

SUBJECT: E.L. VINOGRADOFF - Candidate to join the

Efim Leontievich VINOGRADOFF, Russian of
Jewish origin, was born on January 6, 1898 at Odessa,
South Russia. According to his own statement he left
the U.S.S.R. for Manchuria in 1924 and after a short
stay in Harbin proceeded to Tientsin where he resided
for the following 14 years being first engaged in fur
trade and since 1937-in transport business. He arrived
in Shanghai from Tientsin in March, 1939 and shortly
afterwards established, in partnership with one S.A. Du-
brovo, his own business known as the United Transporters
of Shanghai, 113 Kiukiang Road.

At the time of his arrival in Shanghai Vino-
gradoff was in possession of emigrant passport No.9062
issued on 2-12-36 at Tientsin. On 5-1-38 he applied to
the local Soviet authorities for Soviet citizenship and
holds a certificate to this effect ( No. 3050538 dated
5-1-38 ).

He is married and resides at 357 King Albert
Apartments, Apt. 6.

He is the brother-in-law of Det. Sub-Inspector
D.P. Suhoff of the Municipal Police.

While in Shanghai he did not come to Police
notice.

SUBJECT: F. J. Yankovsky — Candidate for enlistment in the S.M.Police ( Specials ).

Faivel Iosifovich YANKOVSKY, Soviet citizen of Jewish origin, was born on July 1, 1919 at Harbin. In 1932 he graduated from a Higher Elementary School in that city, after which he proceeded to Shanghai together with his parents. Here he was employed as an apprentice radio-mechanic with the Radio Sales Corporation, Nanking Road, from 1934 to 1935, after which he worked independently as a radio salesman until September, 1938 when he was engaged by the Radio Corporation of America, 361/3 Avenue Foch, as Sales Manager . Leaving this position of his own account in September, 1939 he was employed as a Wireless Operator with the Eastern Shipping Agency, Ltd, 55 Yuen Ming Yuen Road, in which capacity he worked on board of their motor vessel " Storm Waif" from 13-8-1940 to 31-12-1940, resigning of his own account. He holds good references from his former employers.

He appears to have been without fixed employment until the end of September, 1941 when he opened an enterprise under the style "United Traders" at 149 Szechuen Road, Room 239, of which, he stated, he is the sole proprietor. The United Traders is supposed to engage in export and import business. Yankovsky admitted that so far practically no business has been done , it being necessary to establish the necessary connections with certain firms in the U.S.A. In the meantime he is engaged in commercial activities as a broker and commission agent.

REPORT
Special Branch Station. File No. Date October 27, 1941
SUBJECT: N.T. Kisliaeff - Candidate to join the S.M.Police ( Specials ).
Nikolai Tarasovich KISLIAEFF, Russian, born on December 5, 1895 at Tomsk, Siberia. Formerly an officer in Admiral Kolchak's army in Siberia he is reported to have left Russia for Manchuria in 1920 and for the following 13 years resided in Harbin. From 1920 to November, 1926 he was employed as an accountant with the Russo-Asiatic Bank and from July, 1927 to October, 1935 - with the Thriftcor Bank, being transferred to Shanghai branch the latter bank in June, 1933.
Following the liquidation of the Thriftcor Bank in May, 1936 he is reported to have been employed in the same capacity with the Asiatic Trading Company, 303 Rue Cardinal Mercier, from 2-6-36 to 15-5-38; with the Lucern Dairy Farm, 381 Great Western Road, from 10-1-37 to 31-10-39; with the Shanghai Trading Corporation, Avenue du Roi Albert, from 29-12-39 to May, 1940 and with the Commercial Trading Company, 320 Szechuen Road, from May, 1940 to 15-10-40, after which he has been employed with the Tientsin Investment Corporation, 51 Canton Road.
He is registered at the Russian Emigrants Committee, Moulmein Road, and at present resides at 55 Rue Moliere, together with his common-law wife and adopted daughter, a student.
While in Shanghai he did not come to Police notice.
A. Prokofieff
D. I.

尼古拉·塔拉索维奇·基斯利亚耶夫（Nikolai Tarasovich KISLIAEFF），俄罗斯人，1895年12月5日出生于西伯利亚托木斯克。据报他曾是西伯利亚高尔察克海军上将军队中的一名军官，于1920年离开俄国前往满洲，并在随后的13年里居住在哈尔滨。从1920年至1926年11月，他在华俄道胜银行担任会计师；从1927年7月至1935年10月，他在节俭银行（Thriftcor Bank）任职，并于1933年6月调至该银行的上海分行。

monial from that firm. At present he conducts his own

SUBJECT: C.N. Shipoff - Applicant to join the S.M.P.
(Specials).

Constantine Nikolaevich SHIPOFF, Russian,
born on January 25, 1905 at St. Petersburg, Russia. Ac-
cording to his own statement, he arrived in Shanghai
from Vladivostok via Harbin some time in 1924. Here he
re-entered the Habarovsk Military Cadets School, which
arrived in Shanghai in 1923. Following his graduation
from the school in the end of 1924 he was employed as
a supervisor with Lafcenti & Yaron, Architects, for a peri-
od in 1925 and since 1926 has been employed with Hong-
kong & Shanghai Hotels, Ltd, his present place of employ-
ment being the Palace Hotel.

He is registered at the Russian Emigrants Com-
mittee and resides at the Palace Hotel.

His father, N.K. Shipoff, 129 Route Vallon, R.5,
is employed at the Park Hotel as a night watchman. At
the same address lives A.N. Shipoff, brother of the appli-
cant, reported to be of unsound mind.

While in Shanghai the applicant did not come to
the notice of the Municipal Police in connection with
any activities of an undesirable nature.

He is a member of the Union of Former Cadets
of the Habarovsk Military Cadets School.

A. Prokopieff
D. I.

SUBJECT: N.F. Yakoonin - Candidate for enlistment in the S.M.Police ( Specials ).

Nikolai Fedorovich YAKOONIN ( Yakunin ), Russian, born on February 15, 1909 at Blagovschensk, Amur Region, Siberia. According to his own statement, he resided in Harbin from 1921 to 1939, during which period he attended a Russian Higher Elementary School in that city, following which he was employed as a shop assistant first with A.F. Chistiakoff, Tea Merchant , for about 1 ½ years and then with Charles Fisher, a German Import & Export firm, from 1929 to July, 1939.

He arrived in Shanghai from Harbin in July, 1939 and soon afterwards secured his present employment with E.D. Sassoon & Co., Ltd. At present he is an assistant to District Engineer, Hamilton House.

While in Harbin his parents became naturalized Chinese citizens, so that the applicant automatically acquired Chinese citizenship. He now holds passport No. 2736 issued on 10-12-38 at Harbin. However, he is registered at the Russian Emigrants Committee, Moulmein Road. His present address is 108/1 Route de Grouchy.

Applicant has two brothers in Shanghai, of whom one ( D.F. Yakoonin ) is now serving in the Russian Auxiliary Detachment, S.M.Police, and the other ( P.F. Yakoonin ) is employed with the Chinese General Omnibus Co as a ticket inspector.

There is nothing in the Municipal Police records detrimental to the character of this person.

It would appear from an interview with the applicant that he is not quite certain about his intention to join the S.M.P. ( Specials ).

尼古拉·费多罗维奇·雅库宁（Nikolai Fedorovich YAKOONIN，亦作Yakunin），俄罗斯人，1909年2月15日出生于西伯利亚阿穆尔州布拉戈维申斯克（Blagovschensk）。据其自述，他于1921年至1939年间居住在哈尔滨，在此期间就读于该市的一所俄罗斯高等小学，随后先是在茶商A.F. Chistiakoff处担任店员约一年半，然后于1929年至1939年7月在德国进出口商行查尔斯·费希尔（Charles Fisher）任职。

他于1939年7月从哈尔滨抵达上海，不久后便在E.D. Sassoon & Co., Ltd.（新沙逊洋行有限公司）获得目前的职位。目前他是汉密尔顿大厦区工程师的助理。

在哈尔滨期间，他的父母归化为中国公民，因此申请人自动获得了中国国籍。他现在持有1938年12月10日在哈尔滨签发的第2736号护照。然而，他在慕尔鸣路俄罗斯侨民委员会进行了登记。他目前的地址是古鲁西路108/1号。

申请人在上海有两个兄弟，其中一人（D.F. Yakoonin）目前在工部局警务处俄罗斯辅助分队服役，另一人（P.F. Yakoonin）受雇于华商公共汽车公司担任查票员。

工部局警务处档案中没有任何有损此人品格的记录。

从与申请人的面谈来看，他对于加入工部局警务处（特别队）的意图似乎不太确定。

Candidate Isidor BOR ( or Eleazar Boris-
vich Bor, as he prefers to call himself ), Russian of
Jewish origin, was born December 19, 1920 at Harbin.
According to his own statement, he resided in Tientsin
together with his parents from 1923 to 1938, during which
period he attended the St. Louis College ( 1930-1936 )
and the North China Russian High School ( 1936 - 1937 ).
He is reported to have arrived in Shanghai from Tientsin
in March, 1938. Here he worked as an apprentice at
Mark Moody's Garage, Rue Bourgeat, from April to August,
1938, after which he was employed with the Mercantile
Service Bureau ( Heng Fung Weaving Co ), 232 Hamilton
House, in the capacity of a supervisor in the Dyeing &
Printing Department of their factory, 660 Rue Brunier de
Montmorand, from 1-8-40 to 1-9-41. He left the latter
position owing to reductions in staff and has since
been without any fixed employment.

He is registered at the Russian Emigrants Com-
mittee, 110 Lain Road, and with the French Police ( Reg.
No. 11154 of 28-10-40 ) and resides at 542 Avenue Joffre,
Apt. 3 together with his parents.

From 14-4-38 to 3-10-40 he was a member of the
Jewish Company, S.V.C., after which he served in the
French Police (Specials) until August, 1941 when that bo-
dy was disbanded. On 27-2-41 he rejoined the Jewish Com-
pany, S.V.C.

Enquiries show that as a volunteer he is rated
as being below average. Moreover, information from two

候选人伊西多尔·博尔（Isidor BOR，或按他更喜欢的方式称为 Eleazar Borisvich Bor），犹太裔俄罗斯人，1920年12月19日出生于哈尔滨。据其自述，他于1923年至1938年间与父母一起居住在天津，在此期间就读于圣路易斯学院（1930-1936年）和华北俄罗斯高中（1936-1937年）。据报道，他于1938年3月从天津抵达上海。在此之后，他于1938年4月至8月在蒲石路马克·穆迪（Mark Moody）汽车修理厂当学徒，随后于1940年8月1日至1941年9月1日受雇于恒丰织造厂（商业服务局），地址为汉密尔顿大厦232号，在其位于蒙莫朗布朗尼路660号的工厂担任印染部主管。由于裁员，他离开了后一个职位，此后一直没有任何固定工作。

他在辣斐德路110号俄罗斯侨民委员会以及法租界巡捕房（1940年10月28日注册，注册号11154）进行了登记，并与父母一起居住在霞飞路542号3室。

SUBJECT: ALVARO AUGUSTO DE BRITTO - Applicant to join
S.M. Police (Specials)

A. A. de Britto, Portuguese, was born in
Macau on July, 2nd 1900. He was educated in the Macau
Seminary and Escola Commercial.

He arrived in Shanghai early in 1922 and join-
ed the Hongkong & Shanghai Bank staff when in 1924 he
was transferred to the Tsingtao branch until 1933 when
he resigned and returned to Shanghai. He then worked in
various capacities, in the advertising section of the
S'hai Evening Post & Mercury and as salesman for the
Mustard Co. In January, 1939, he joined the Import Dept
of Messrs Jardines & Matheson, where he is still employed
He is married but is living apart from his wife.

When in Macau, he served 2 years with the
Macau Volunteers and for 4 years was a member of the
Hongkong Police Reserve, from 1915 to 1919. In Shanghai
he joined the Portuguese Company of the S.V.C. and has
served approximately 10 years with a good record. He has
resigned in the rank of a Sergeant but has not yet obta-
ined his discharge papers, owing to the temporary disban-
dment of the S.V.C.

There is nothing detrimental to his character in
Police records. He may be considered a suitable applic-
ant owing to his past experience in volunteer work and
the use of arms.

A. A. de Britto，葡萄牙人，1900年7月2日出生于澳门。他在澳门神学院和商业学校接受教育。

他于1922年初抵达上海，并加入汇丰银行职员队伍，1924年被调往青岛分行，直到1933年辞职返回上海。此后他从事各种工作，在《上海晚邮报与水星报》的广告部工作，并担任Mustard Co.的销售员。1939年1月，他加入怡和洋行进口部，至今仍在那里工作。他已婚，但与妻子分居。

在澳门期间，他在澳门义勇队服役2年，并于1915年至1919年间担任香港警察后备队成员4年。在上海，他加入了万国商团葡萄牙连，服役约10年，记录良好。他以警士军衔辞职，但由于万国商团暂时解散，尚未获得退伍证明。

警务档案中没有任何有损其品格的记录。鉴于他过去在志愿工作和使用武器方面的经验，可以认为他是一位合适的申请人。

Mr. Carlos Jose Sousa, age 26, Portuguese,
(Passport No. 3328 issued by Portuguese Consulate in Shanghai on 25-11-41) residing 344 Seymour Road, states he was born in Shanghai on 22-5-1915 and that his parents have been dead for a number of years. . His father was formerly employed by the Chinese Maritime Customs.

The applicant attended St. Francis Xavier's School from 1926 until he graduated in 1935, and shortly after leaving school, obtained employment with the Bakerite Co., 1432 Sinsa Road, in a clerical capacity, where he is still employed. He was a member of the Filipino Co., S.V.C. for about seven years, but resigned on 3-9-41 "for business reasons" and filed to apply for his discharge papers. Enquiries at S.V.C. Headquarters revealed that applicant had a good record. A friend of the applicant, Mr. H.B. Rowsell, British, Lane 1231/5 Avenue Road, employee of Arnhold & Co., Sassoon House, when approached, stated he had known the applicant for many years and that in his opinion the applicant is a person of sound character.

Mr. Jordon, assistant manager of the Bakerite Co., stated he had no objection to Mr. Sousa joining the S. M. P. (Specials).

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE No. S. B. 5857/150 Date 17-4-42）

S. S. D. Special Branch Station. File No.................... Date April 9, 1942.

SUBJECT: Martin KURNIK - Applicant for Enrolment in the S. M. "Special Police".

With reference to the attached application to join the S. M. "Special Police", submitted by Mr. Martin Kurnik, the following particulars have been obtained:-

Mr. Martin KURNIK, German Jewish refugee, single, born in Briesen, Germany, 42 years ago, arrived in Shanghai on April 7, 1940. He has come to the notice of the Police in connection with a religious lecture he proposed to read in May 1940 at the International Restaurant, 81 Chusan Road, which was not permitted as the Police thought it inadvisable to allow public meetings in licensed premises. Mr. Kurnik is well-known to local refugee circles for his religious fervour.

There seems to be no doubt regarding Mr. Martin Kurnik's integrity of character, it is, however, thought that he is at present neither physically nor mentally fit to become a member of the S. M. Police. The strain experienced in the past by a great number of local refugee residents has left a deep mark on the body and mind of Mr. Martin Kurnik. He has no fixed occupation and is supported by his brother, who is the owner of a foreign lodging house at 302/21 Ward Road.

Mr. Martin Kurnik was interviewed by this section and it was noticed that he is under the impression that the "Special" Police is a remunerated occupation, and was very disappointed to hear that the work done by this body is entirely voluntary. He was, therefore, advised to make an additional application should he still desire to join the S. M. P. (Specials).

Officer i/c Special Branch.

主题：马丁·库尔尼克（Martin KURNIK）- 申请加入工部局“特别警察”。

关于马丁·库尔尼克先生提交的加入工部局“特别警察”的附带申请，已获得以下详情：-

马丁·库尔尼克先生，德籍犹太难民，单身，42年前出生于德国布里森（Briesen），于1940年4月7日抵达上海。他曾因提议于1940年5月在中山路81号国际餐厅举行宗教讲座而引起警方注意，该许可未获批准，因为警方认为在持牌场所允许公众集会是不明智的。库尔尼克先生因其宗教热情而为当地难民圈子所熟知。

马丁·库尔尼克先生的品格正直无疑，然而，目前认为他在身体和精神上都不适合成为工部局警务处的成员。过去许多当地难民居民所经历的压力给马丁·库尔尼克先生的身心留下了深刻的印记。他没有固定职业，由其兄弟供养，其兄弟是华德路302/21号一家外侨寄宿公寓的业主。

本部门对马丁·库尔尼克先生进行了面谈，注意到他误以为“特别”警察是有薪职业，并在得知该机构的工作完全是志愿性质后感到非常失望。因此，建议如果他仍希望加入工部局警务处（特别队），应另行提出申请。

特科科长。

Shanghai 8th of March 1942.

To the Commissioner of the Shanghai Municipal Police.
Mr. Masami Katari, personal

I beg to inform you that I was a German soldier and fighter at the
front. I apply for a position as a policeman if possible with the Special
Police. I am thoroughly physically trained and am a good shooter
with pistol and rifle as well. I am used to strict military discipline
and obedience and am not a convict. I am 42 years of age. I enclose
a picture of mine as a soldier.

Furthermore I enclose a photo-copy which proves that the cross
of honour for front-soldiers was granted to me in the name of the
Führer and Chancellor Adolf Hitler on April 15th, 1935. Its confirmation
you will see on its back. I kindly ask for returning both. #

Yours obediently

Martin Kurnik, Shanghai-Hongkew,
302/21, Ward Road.

# Returned to
Kurnik on
21. 3. 42.
Ja. Pices.

正田雅美（Masami Katari）先生 亲启

谨此告知，我曾是一名德国士兵及前线战斗人员。如有可能，我申请在特别警察队担任警员一职。我受过全面的体能训练，且擅长使用手枪和步枪射击。我习惯于严格的军事纪律与服从，且无犯罪记录。我现年42岁。随函附上我身着军装的照片一张。

此外，另附一份照片副本，证明我于1935年4月15日以元首兼总理阿道夫·希特勒的名义获授前线战士荣誉十字勋章。其背面可见认证信息。恳请阅后归还上述两件物品。#

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
REPORT
Special Branch. Station. File No. Date January 20, 1942.

SUBJECT: Alexander WEINBERG - Applicant for
Enrolment in the Shanghai Municipal Police (Specials).

Alexander WEINBERG, German Jewish refugee,
in possession of a German "J" passport No. 22413, was
born in Vienna on September 8, 1886, and arrived in
Shanghai on March 20, 1939 aboard the s.s. "Victoria".
The applicant is married, his wife, however,
remained in Germany. He resides at Lane 725, House 49,
Tongshan Road.
Following his arrival in Shanghai, Mr. A.
Weinberg secured employment with the Committee for the
Assistance of European Jewish Refugees in Shanghai, as
manager of the pharmacy at 138 Ward Road (Refugee Camp).
He still holds this position.
Although Mr. Weinberg has a certain knowledge
of the English language, it is thought that it is not
sufficient to pass the prescribed training course for
recruits, and it is, therefore, respectfully suggested
that Mr. A. Weinberg be told to re-apply at some future
date, when his English has improved.
There is nothing to the detriment of the
applicant in S.M.Police records.

事由：亚历山大·温伯格（Alexander WEINBERG）——申请加入上海公共租界工部局警务处（特别队）。

亚历山大·温伯格，德籍犹太难民，持有德国“J”字护照第22413号，1886年9月8日出生于维也纳，于1939年3月20日乘“维多利亚”号轮船抵达上海。申请人已婚，但其妻子仍留在德国。他居住在同山路725弄49号。

抵达上海后，A. 温伯格先生在援助欧洲犹太难民委员会获得职位，担任华德路138号（难民营）药房经理。他目前仍担任此职。

尽管温伯格先生具备一定的英语知识，但被认为不足以通过为新进人员规定的培训课程，因此谨建议告知A. 温伯格先生，待其英语水平提高后，于将来某个日期重新提出申请。
